title: Current DSH GAT behavioral baseline is an uncommitted working-tree state
content: The selected DSH baseline is rooted at commit aeedf19995babaa28e35ca84624baff18a77a7d8 but all relevant gat-core/tools/profile/web feature files are modified or untracked. Synchronization must pin file hashes and cannot cite the commit alone as the behavioral revision.

title: DSH GAT Web mount and component contracts drift
content: Current DSH gat-web mount removes approveMission/importApprovedPlan injections while the identical TeamActionInjected interface still requires them; its component test also omits required enabled/enable fields. Blind baseline copying would create type or test drift.
